name: Data Analyzer: Text can be read from the sample PDF data dictionary
objective: Shows the PDF reading step returns real text from the first 5 pages.
precondition: Offline test harness; the sample PDF LTCPROMISE8314QC.pdf must be present. No AI model is used.

steps.action: Extract text from the first five pages of the fixture PDF
steps.expected: Text is not empty and contains the form title 'LTC-PROMISE.8314_QC' and the field markers '[record_id] text' and '[consent_date] text (date_mdy) Required'.

name: Data Analyzer: PDF text is extracted, then passed to a replaced (mocked) AI parser
objective: Shows real PDF reading works and the parser is called once with that text. The AI answer is a canned one written in the test, so the checks on fields only confirm the canned answer, not the real parser.
precondition: No network and no AI model: the AI parser is replaced by a canned answer of three made-up fields (record_id, age, visit_date). The sample PDF must be present.

steps.action: Extract text from the first 5 pages
Call the replaced parser with the text and a 500-field limit
steps.expected: Parser called exactly once with the same text and limit; answer has fields and at least one chunk processed (both come from the canned answer)

name: Data Analyzer: Live AI model reads the whole sample PDF dictionary
objective: Optional live check that the real AI model extracts fields from the full PDF.
precondition: Skipped unless RUN_LIVE_LLM_TESTS=1. Needs network, Azure OpenAI sign-in and a live AI model; not part of the offline suite.

steps.action: Extract all text from the sample PDF and send it to the live AI parser
steps.expected: At least one field returned and at least one chunk processed
